briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4.5 escalate multi-agent AGI race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid intensifying competition. Compute constraints and safety concerns shape strategic decisions across the ecosystem.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning. Anthropic's Claude 4.5 shows gains in agentic workflows while Google DeepMind and xAI push multimodal frontiers.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp and new Microsoft-Oracle data center deals drive capacity. TSMC reports record AI chip orders for Q4 2026.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory harmonization slow the US-China AGI gap or accelerate covert compute races?
